title: Delivery receipt acknowledgement
description: Body of the 200 response to POST /v1/receipts (plan 15.3, 16.2): the Mac recorded the receipt, or had recorded the same receipt_id with the same body before (duplicate true, nothing changed). queue_entry_id and entry_state are always present and null for an item fetched from the catalog without a queue entry; entry_state is the queue entry's state after this receipt, which never moves backwards (a late downloaded_to_phone after imported_into_sylvia leaves it imported). Moved from the OpenAPI document's inline components/schemas/ReceiptAck at the M0 final fix (contracts review R1-06), unchanged.

queue_entry_id.description: The device-inbox entry the receipt was for, or null for a catalog download without a queue entry.

entry_state.description: The queue entry's state after this receipt; null for a catalog download without a queue entry.

duplicate.description: True when this receipt_id was already recorded with the same body.
